route.name: Lehmen - Treis Karden (via Eltz) 30 km ENG 2025

course_points.n: Turn slight right onto Winninger Straße, B 416
Turn slight left onto Alte Moselstraße
Turn right onto Alte Moselstraße, B 416
Turn sharp right onto Moselkerner Weg
Turn left onto B 49 and take B 49 toward Koblenz, Treis
At roundabout, take exit 1 onto Brückenstraße
